Title: Spring Data Azure Cosmos DB SDK v3.0.0 release now available

Body.Content: Now generally available, the Spring Data Azure Cosmos DB SDK v3.0.0 release brings @Query annotation support and support for v4.0.0 of the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK. This enables you to use Spring Data framework with the Azure Cosmos DB Java SDK for Core (SQL) API. Additionally, v3.0.0 supports multi-database applications, @GeneratedValue and @Version annotations, plus a new auditing framework. The Maven artifact group ID is now com.azure, and the artifact name is azure-spring-data-cosmos. This artifact can be configured to pull spring-data framework 2.2 or 2.3 using the spring boot dependencies bill of materials (BOM) file. Please note the source code has moved to Azure SDK for Java.
